name: Tool Proficiency
text: When you adopt this specialization at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with woodcarver's tools.

name: Tool Proficiency
text: When you adopt this specialization at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with smith's tools.

name: Tools of the Trade
text: 3rd-level Armorer feature You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

name: Tough
text: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat.

name: Training in War and Song (Bladesinging)
text: When you adopt this tradition at 2nd level, you gain proficiency with light armor, and you gain proficiency with one type of one-handed melee weapon of your choice.

name: Trance of Order
text: 14th-level Clockwork Soul feature You gain the ability to align your consciousness to the endless calculations of Mechanus.

name: Tranquility
text: Beginning at 11th level, you can enter a special meditation that surrounds you with an aura of peace.

name: Transmuter's Stone
text: Starting at 6th level, you can spend 8 hours creating a transmuter's stone that stores transmutation magic.

name: Tundra
text: You gain resistance to cold damage, and you don't suffer the effects of extreme cold, as described in the Dungeon Master's Guide.

name: Turn the Tide
text: As a bonus action, you can bolster injured creatures with your Channel Divinity.

name: Umbral Form
text: Starting at 18th level, you can spend 6 sorcery points as a bonus action to magically transform yourself into a shadowy form.

name: Unarmored Movement
text: Starting at 2nd level, your speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield.

name: Unbreakable Majesty
text: At 14th level, your appearance permanently gains an otherworldly aspect that makes you look more lovely and fierce.

name: Undead Thralls
text: At 6th level, you add the animate dead spell to your spellbook if it is not there already.

name: Undying Nature
text: Beginning at 10th level, you can hold your breath indefinitely, and you don't require food, water, or sleep, although you still require rest to reduce exhaustion and still benefit from finishing short and long rests.

name: Unearthly Recovery
text: At 18th level, you gain the ability to overcome grievous injuries.

name: Unsettling Words
text: 3rd-level College of Eloquence feature You can spin words laced with magic that unsettle a creature and cause it to doubt itself.

name: Unstoppable
text: At 14th level, your fury in battle makes you unstoppable.

name: Unwavering Mark
text: Starting at 3rd level, you can menace your foes, foiling their attacks and punishing them for harming others.

name: Unyielding Spirit
text: Starting at 15th level, you have advantage on saving throws to avoid becoming paralyzed or stunned.

name: Vanish
text: Starting at 14th level, you can use the Hide action as a bonus action on your turn.

name: Versatile Trickster
text: At 13th level, you gain the ability to distract targets with your mage hand.

name: Vigilant Blessing
text: 1st-level Twilight Domain feature The night has taught you to be vigilant.

name: Vigor of the Hill Giant
text: You've manifested the resilience emblematic of hill giants, granting you the following benefits:Ability Score Increase.

name: Visage of the Astral Self
text: 6th-level Way of the Astral Self feature You can summon the visage of your astral self.

name: Vow of Enmity
text: As a bonus action, you can utter a vow of enmity against a creature you can see within 10 feet of you, using your Channel Divinity.

name: Wails from the Grave
text: 3rd-level Phantom feature As you nudge someone closer to the grave, you can channel the power of death to harm someone else as well.

name: War Caster
text: You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat, learning techniques that grant you the following benefits:You have advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain your concentration on a spell when you take damage.

name: War Magic
text: Beginning at 7th level, when you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

name: War Priest
text: From 1st level, your god delivers bolts of inspiration to you while you are engaged in battle.

name: Warding Flare
text: When you choose this domain at 1st level, you can interpose divine light between yourself and an attacking enemy.

name: Warding Flare
text: Also at 1st level, you can interpose divine light between yourself and an attacking enemy.

name: Warding Maneuver
text: At 7th level, you learn to fend off strikes directed at you, your mount, or other creatures nearby.

name: Watcher's Will
text: You can use your Channel Divinity to invest your presence with the warding power of your faith.

name: Waxing and Waning
text: 6th-Level Lunar Sorcery Feature You gain greater control over the phases of your lunar magic.

name: Way of the Long Death
text: Monks of the Way of the Long Death are obsessed with the meaning and mechanics of dying.

name: Weapon Bond
text: At 3rd level, you learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one weapon.

name: Weapon Master
text: You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons, gaining the following benefits:Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.

name: Whispers of the Dead
text: 3rd-level Phantom feature Echoes of those who have died cling to you.

name: Wild Magic Surge
text: Starting when you choose this origin at 1st level, your spellcasting can unleash surges of untamed magic.

name: Wild Shape
text: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your action to magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before.

name: Wild Surge
text: 3rd-level Path of Wild Magic feature The magical energy roiling inside you sometimes erupts from you.

name: Wings Unfurled
text: 6th-level Way of the Ascendant Dragon feature When you use your Step of the Wind, you can unfurl spectral draconic wings from your back that vanish at the end of your turn.

name: Wizardly Quill
text: 2nd-level Order of Scribes feature As a bonus action, you can magically create a Tiny quill in your free hand.

name: Wolf
text: While you're raging, you can use a bonus action on your turn to knock a Large or smaller creature prone when you hit it with melee weapon attack.

name: Wolf
text: While you're raging, your friends have advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of you that is hostile to you.

name: Writhing Tide
text: 7th-level Swarmkeeper feature You can condense part of your swarm into a focused mass that lifts you up.

name: Zealous Presence
text: At 10th level, you learn to channel divine power to inspire zealotry in others.
